findings.description: When the target already exists, the function returns early without removing the temporary file at `incoming`. Every duplicate upload leaves a full-size `upload-<uuid>` file in `incoming/`, so disk usage grows without bound. The old code wrote no temp file in this case.
findings.suggestion: Call `incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True)` before returning on the duplicate path, and also clean up if `_path_for`, `mkdir` or `os.replace` raises.
findings.title: Temp upload file leaked when blob already exists

findings.description: The cleanup `try/except` covers only the write loop. If `target.parent.mkdir` or `os.replace` raises (permissions, disk error), the temp file stays in `incoming/` forever.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the finalize steps in a try/except that unlinks `incoming` on failure.
findings.title: No cleanup of temp file if mkdir or replace fails
